# Encryption compatibility fixture

`age-0.12.1-scrypt.age` was generated by `ps_core::crypto::encrypt_markdown`
with age 0.12.1 before the T-226 dependency change. It contains only public
test data, encrypted with the public passphrase `test-only long passphrase`.
The exact BOM/Unicode/mixed-line-ending plaintext is asserted in `tests/crypto.rs`.

Keep this historical ciphertext unchanged: regenerating it with the current
dependency would stop testing compatibility with existing user documents.
